name: nearneighbour_escarpment
title: Near-neighbour contours on an escarpment
description: A narrow, steep-sided plateau squeezed against a tilted base. Several contour levels run within a few metres of one another along its flanks, which exercises welding and constraint preservation where lines come close but never touch.

meta.z_datum: asset-local datum (0 m at the recipe base plane)

provenance.derivation: terrain raster written from the analytic surface, re-parsed, then marching-squares level sets clipped exactly to boundary and holes; rings split at contour meeting points so constraints are representable
